# Agent Factory

> Run a versioned factory against caller-supplied records from a CLI or HTTP client.

- [Harness quick start](docs/HARNESSES.md): Python and Node entry points, prerequisites and JSON output.
- [HTTP API](docs/API.md): run lifecycle, review, chat and version conflicts.
- [Workspace settings schema](internal/settings/workspace.schema.json): machine-readable field types, defaults, descriptions and bounds.
- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): deployment variables, model routing, storage and memory.
- [Source mapping](docs/MAPPING.md): inspect a payload, preview a mapping and pin it for a run.
- [Tool configuration](docs/HTTP_TOOLS.md): REST, MCP, grants, evidence and external change proposals.
- [Rendered page evidence](docs/BROWSER_CAPTURE.md) for Playwright tool definitions, pack grants and immutable review captures.
- [Project status](docs/STATUS.md): verification and outstanding work.
- [Pack rule schema](schemas/rule.schema.json) for validating individual YAML or JSON rules with `factory validate --rule FILE...`.
- [OpenAPI tool import](docs/HTTP_TOOLS.md#generate-tool-definitions-from-openapi) for offline generation of reviewable GET evidence tools.
- [Evidence tool file schema](schemas/evidence-tools.schema.json) for validating HTTP and MCP configuration with `factory validate --tools FILE...`.
- [Production deployment](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) for digest-pinned Helm releases, PostgreSQL and Secret references.
